# Lab 8.7: Create an IAM Deny Policy

## What We Are Going to Do
Stop everyone except a security group from deleting the project, even people who hold the Owner role.

## Steps

1. **Get the Deny Admin role.** An organization admin grants you **Deny Admin** (`roles/iam.denyAdmin`) on the organization.

2. **Write the deny policy.** Create `deny.json`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • JSON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">{
  "displayName": "Block project deletion",
  "rules": [
    {
      "denyRule": {
        "deniedPrincipals": ["principalSet://goog/public:all"],
        "exceptionPrincipals": ["principalSet://goog/group/security-admins@YOUR_DOMAIN"],
        "deniedPermissions": ["cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects.delete"]
      }
    }
  ]
}</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Attach it to the project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam policies create block-project-delete \
  --attachment-point=cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID \
  --kind=denypolicies \
  --policy-file=deny.json</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Test it.** As a user with **Owner** who is not in `security-admins`, try to delete the project in **IAM & Admin → Settings → Shut down**. The request is denied.

5. **List and view deny policies.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam policies list \
  --attachment-point=cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID \
  --kind=denypolicies</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam policies delete block-project-delete \
  --attachment-point=cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID \
  --kind=denypolicies</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Owner without exception | Cannot delete the project |
| security-admins group | Still can |
| Evaluation order | Deny is checked before allow |
| Permission format | `service.googleapis.com/resource.action` |
